attractions.name: Kisama (Naga Heritage Village) – Hornbill Festival
attractions.description: Venue of the Hornbill Festival, a cultural showcase of Naga tribes with dances, crafts, food stalls, competitions and traditional performances; night carnival often after sunset
tips: Festival runs Dec 1–10 and draws many visitors
Arrive early for prime seating at performances
Carry cash as many stalls accept only cash

attractions.name: Hornbill Festival, Kisama (Naga Heritage Village)
attractions.description: Cultural showcase of Naga tribes with dances, crafts, food stalls, competitions and traditional performances; night carnival often after sunset
attractions.hours: Main cultural programs run in the daytime, typically starting in the morning and continuing through the afternoon
tips: Held Dec 1–10 and draws many visitors
Arrive early for prime seating at performances
Carry cash as many stalls accept only cash
Buy tribal handcrafts directly from artisans

attractions.name: Kisama Heritage Village
attractions.description: Site of the Hornbill Festival grounds, with traditional morungs (tribal huts) representing different Naga tribes, showing architectural styles, cultural symbols and lifestyle.
